text:
Hi all,

We would greatly appreciate your advice and recent experiences 🙏

We are unmarried, have been together 2.5 years. My boyfriend is Israeli, I am Australian and British. 

We made the inital online B1 application in March 2026, under the Tel Aviv branch.
He is in Israel, I am out of Israel. 

We are a straightforward case and nothing complex.

We have heard nothing since we made our application. 5 months now.

My boyfriend has been several times to the office to enquire. They said our case has been assigned to someone, but we don't even know if anyone is actually working on it. 

Obviously, you guys know how it feels - sad and distressing. 

It would be really helpful to know...

A) what are the wait times you have experienced to hear back from the TLV office once you made the inital application?

B) Would it be beneficial to engage with a lawyer to get them to push things along?

Toda raba! 
Thanks for your thoughts in advance 🧡🧡🧡
